# Locations & Battles

## Academy {#academy}

Located in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) near a quiet neighborhood, the Academy is an educational institution where students are organized into classes to pursue teacher's licenses, compete for medals and scholarships, and engage in their studies.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P7](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P8](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. **Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)

## Avenue {#avenue}

The Avenue is a four- or five-hundred-yard stretch of road leading to [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge), lined with old apple trees whose canopy creates a snowy, fragrant tunnel of bloom.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P40](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER II. ## Avonlea {#avonlea}

Avonlea is the hometown of a group of young scholars who left to attend the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P1](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P2](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. **Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Bentley](../character/bentley.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)

> During class at the Avonlea schoolhouse, [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tries to get Anne's attention by pulling her hair and calling her "Carrots." Furious at the insult, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) smashes her slate over Gilbert's head. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand at the blackboard with a message criticizing her temper, and afterward [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) ignores Gilbert's contrite attempt to apologize.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

## Birch Path {#birch-path}

Named by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), the Birch Path is a picturesque, narrow, and spicy-aired pathway fringed with young birches and wildflowers that winds through Mr. Bell's woods on the route to the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P70](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Bolingbroke {#bolingbroke}

Bolingbroke is a place in [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) was born, featuring a high school where her parents taught and a small yellow house where her family lived before she became an orphan.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P7](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P8](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER V. ## Boston {#boston}

Boston is a city where [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md) Pye's mother's cousin resides, married to a man who attended school with a distinguished, dark-haired artist.

## Bright River {#bright-river}

Bright River is a location reachable by an eight-mile drive from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) Cuthbert's home, featuring a train station house with a long platform and ladies' waiting room, as well as a small local hotel.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P12](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P14](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER I. > [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) arrives at Bright River station expecting to pick up an orphan boy, only to discover a young girl waiting for him instead. Unable to bring himself to tell her about the mistake, he decides to bring her home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and let [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) deal with it. As they begin their drive, the girl talks incessantly, expressing her imagination and delight, which [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) finds surprisingly enjoyable.
>

## Green Gables {#green-gables}

Green Gables is the secluded, meticulously kept homestead of [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), situated at the edge of their cleared land in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), reachable by a long, rose-bordered lane, and featuring an orchard-embowered house and a very neat yard.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER I. **Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up at Green Gables, marvels at the beautiful scenery, and eats a quiet breakfast with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). She helps [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) with the household chores and gives names to the bedroom cherry tree and a geranium. After dinner, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) set off in the buggy for [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) to resolve Anne's placement with Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md).
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) up to bed and instructs her to fold her clothes and say her prayers. Discovering [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has never prayed before, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) has her improvise a prayer at her knee, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) ends like a letter. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) then goes downstairs to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), resolved to teach [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) proper religious and practical manners.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers

The following day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends Sunday school alone in her plain clothes decorated with wild flowers and finds the experience dull, especially compared to the other girls in puffed sleeves. ## Lake of Shining Waters {#lake-of-shining-waters}

The Lake of Shining Waters is the imaginative name given by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to Barry's pond, a long, winding body of water with shifting hues and a middle bridge near [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P52](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0052), [v1 CHAPTER II. ## Lover {#lover}

Lover's Lane is a romantic pathway extending from below the [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) orchard to the end of the [Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) farm, used for bringing wood home and taking cows to the back pasture.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P70](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Lynde’s Hollow {#lynde-s-hollow}

Lynde’s Hollow is a dip in the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) main road traversed by a quiet stream and fringed with alders and ladies' eardrops where Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) resides.

## Marysville {#marysville}

Marysville is a place where Mr. and Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) moved after leaving [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), and where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) lived with them until she was eight years old.

## Merry Christmas {#merry-christmas}

On a snow-covered Christmas morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) greeted [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) before being surprised with a fashionable brown gloria dress with puffed sleeves from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), a matching hair ribbon from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and a pair of dainty kid slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXV. ## New Brunswick {#new-brunswick}

New Brunswick is a location where Mrs. Rachel heard of an adopted orphan girl who poisoned her family's well, and where [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) spent a summer visiting his cousins.

Nova Scotia is a location that houses an orphan asylum and is situated in close proximity to the Island.

## Orchard Slope {#orchard-slope}

Orchard Slope is the home of [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and Mr. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), located past a brook and through fir trees from Anne's residence, with its western gable visible through a gap in the woods.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P11](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P12](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P13](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P14](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0014), +6 more_

**Associated with:** [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md)

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her decorated hat before taking her to Orchard Slope to meet [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). In the garden, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) become instant friends and swear a solemn oath of friendship. Returning home happily, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a treat of chocolates from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits to herself that she is becoming fond of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P42](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046)_

> After discussing her latest blunder with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to Orchard Slope to apologize directly to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for jumping onto her bed. Her honest confession and imaginative explanations charm Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) into staying in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and continuing Diana's music lessons.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

## Violet Vale {#violet-vale}

Named by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Violet Vale is a little green dimple situated beyond [Willowmere](../codex/places.md#willowmere) in the shadow of Mr. Andrew Bell's big woods, famous for having millions of violets in the spring.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P70](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## White Sands Hotel {#white-sands-hotel}

Located along the shore road, the White Sands Hotel is run by Mr. Kirke and serves as a summer resort popular with American visitors.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P22](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P23](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P24](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0024), +18 more_

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress for her recital at the White Sands Hotel, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) pops in to offer her own proud yet gruff commentary. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rides to the hotel with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Billy](../character/billy.md), where she experiences severe stage fright before performing. After catching sight of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the crowd, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds her courage, gives an outstanding performance that earns an encore, and enjoys the post-concert reception.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P1](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII.
